input.body:
From: Varan Shipping - Chartering Dept. <chartering@varanshipping.com> 
Sent: Wednesday, 21 March 2018 16:45
To: chartering <chartering@etm-services.net>
Cc: ETMS Management <management@etm-services.net>;
director@etm-services.net; Varan Shipping - Chartering Dept.
<chartering@varanshipping.com>
Subject: MV NORTHSTAR GLORY, FDF / ALEX, RECAP OF AGREED TERMS

 

Dear Mohamed / Elif

 

Good Afternoon,

 

Pls kindly find below recap of agreed terms for owners final confirmation in
order to apply for subs,

Personally I believe it will nıt take long to get conf from all parties.

 

I added one final terms which I believe would not cause any problem to
owners;

-IN CHRTRS OPTION TO TRANSMIT THE FREIGHT FROM A GUARANTEED NOMINEE OR THEIR
AGENT IN TURKEY, AGAINST FREIGHT INVOICE ADDRESED TO THE REMITTER.

 



''MV NORTHSTAR GLORY''
PANAMA FLAG, 1992 BLT,IACS CLASS-IMO:9033854 BOX - DOUBLE SKIN,- GEARLESS
GRT/NRT/DWT 2498/874/3.858 TON ON 5.84 MTR LOA/BEAM/DEPTH MOULDED
94.5/14.00/7,00 MTR GRAIN/BALE 3000/2950 CBM - 3.600 CC / BOX / IMO 1
Fitted - KOREA CLASS, 2HO/ 2HA HATCH NO 1&2 : 25,0 X 9,5 meters
No.1 Hold: 27.50 x 9.50 x 6.00 mtr
No.2 Hold: 26.25 x 9.50 x 6.00 mtr
Hold Ceeling Strengthened for Heavy Cargoes TANKTOP STRENGTHS: 18MT/SQM
IMO 1.1 & App B Fitted A/D/A-WOG


-ETA Leixoes on 24th Marc/ETS 26th pm hrs agw(cargo is 1000 tons ferroalloys
cargo)
-ETA Bareiro on 27th March 2018 pm hrs wp iagw,ETS on 28 th pm hrs wp
iagw.(cargo is 1500 tons ferroalloys cargo)
-ETA El Ferrol on 30th March 2018 early am hrs,ETS same day agw.(cargo is
500 tons ferroalloys cargo)
-ETA Figuera de Foz will be on 01th April 2018 agw.


- draft of the vessel on 3000 mts; - Max Draft 5,50 metres

Owners confirm

-suitable to load the cgo she has been fixed for with all valid
certificates on board  including: memo of Paris cargo securing manual/trim
and stability/bulk loading manual(booklet)certificate according to solas
ch vi part b reg.7(2)/ vessel to be fully suitable and fully fitted to
load present cargo owners guarantee that the vessel is fully suitable and
fully fitted for shipment of the cargo she has been fixed for and that all
pertaining international certificates are on board. also owners guarantee
that the vessel is suitable for grab loading/discharge and that all the
spaces are accessible for bulk cargo and for grab loading/discharge.
-vsl to be in possession of approved grain/bulk cargo loading plan in
accordance with local and international regulations.
-vsl to be in possession of all the required documentation to pass
successfully the ordinary stability calculation/inspection by local
harbour master office.
-from the date of coming into force of the international safety management
(ism) code in relation to the vessel and thereafter during the currency of
this c/p, the owners shall procure that both the vessel and '' the
company''
( as defined by the ism code) shall comply with the requirements of the
ism code.
upon request the owners shall provide a copy of the relevant document of
compliance (doc) and safety managment certificate (smc) to the charterers.
except as otherwise provided in this c/p, loss, damage, expense or    delay
caused
by failure on the part of the owners or '' the company ''  to comply with
the
ism code shall be for the owners' account.
-from the date of coming into force of the international code for the
security of ships and of port facilities and the relevant amendments to
chapter xi of solas (isps code) in relation to the vessel, the owners
shall procure that both the vessel and "the company" (as defined by the
isps code) shall comply with the requirements of the isps code relating to
the
vessel and "the company".

FOR:

- SUBS/SHIPPERS /RECIEVERS  /UNDERWRITTERS   APPROVAL  TO BE LIFTED UPON
FIXING  MAINTERS LATEST  W/I 24W HRS

-CHARTERERS : LEPRO TRADE LP  IRELAND 

 - LAST FIXTURES
MV VON PERLE: ANTALYA / KHERSON, 3600 MTONS, BARYTE IN BIG BAGS, OWNERS:
KILYOS, CP: 02.11.2017 MV AVRA : AVEIRO / ALEXANDRIA, 3600 MTS CLAY,
OWNERS: LIDMAR SHIPPING, CP:24.05.2017 MV SPANIA : TRABZON / POTI, 3001
MTS BATIRE IN BULK: BSS GMBH, CP: 20.04.2017 MV  VON PERLE : TEIGHNMOUTH /
ALEXANDRIA 3000 MTS CLAY IN BULK: NISMAR SHIPPING LTD, CP DD: 26.01.2017
MV JAZZ: ISKENDERUN / OCHAKOV, 3609 MTS CALCIUM CARBONATE: MCE KARGO, CP
DD: 22.02.2017

-LOADING PORT     : FIGUERA DE FOZ, PORTUGAL

-DISCHARGING PORT :ALEXANDRIA   EGYPT  1 GSP AAAA OR 1 SAFE ANCHORAGE IN
CHOPT

-OWNERS STATISY THEMSELVES WITH RESTIRCTIONS DRAFT/LENGTH/BEAM ETC OF THE
PORTS  BOTH ENDS
-LAYCAN :   02/05 April 2018
-CARGO : Min/Max 3.000 tons ( clay and kaolin ) stw=dwt

-OWNERS CONFIRM VSL HAS ABT 3.000 CBM HOLD GRAIN CAPACITY

GRADES  AS FOLLOWS.
1700 San10
800 EN17
500 ALVRIUM


-OWNERS, CHRTRS, SHIPPERS CONFIRM CARGO SEPERATION AS PER ATTACHED CARGO
PLAN.
-SEPERATION AND TARPOLIN WILL BE FOR CHARTERERS ACCOUNT, HOWEVER VESSEL CREW
WILL HELP STEVEDORS FOR THE PLACEMENT OF THE TARPOLIN.
-SOLE OR PART CARGO IN OO, CLAY CARGO TO BE LOADED UNDERDECK, PART CARGO
OPTION IS ONLY FOR ON DECK CARGOS.
-FREIGHT: EURO 28 .- PMT FIOST  L/S/D

 

-IN CHRTRS OPTION TO TRANSMIT THE FREIGHT FROM A GUARANTEED NOMINEE OR THEIR
AGENT IN TURKEY, AGAINST FREIGHT INVOICE ADDRESED TO THE REMITTER.

-FIOST FREIGHT FULLY PAID  WITHIN 3 BD FM S/R BS/L ANYCASE MKD''FREIGHT
PAYBALE  AT DESTINATION " DUE TO LETTER OF CREDIT MATTERS  BUT CHARTERERS
TO PAY FREIGHT  ACCORDING TO CHARTER PARTY.

-IN CASE ORIGINAL BS/L NOT AVAILABLE AT DISCH PORT OWS AGREE TO DELIVER
CGO AGAINST  PRESENTATION OF L.O.I ON OWNERS STANDARD PANDI WORDING W/O
BANK GUARANTEE ISSUED AND SIGNED BY CHRTS -FREIGHT EARNED ON SIGNING BS/L
DISCOUNTLESS AND NON RETURNABLE SHIP AND OR CGO LOST OR NOT LOST.

-NOTICES:  2/1 DAYS DEFINITE NOTICE

-LOADING/DISCH  5 TTL  WWDAYS OF 24 CONSEC HOURS SSHEX/TFHEX

-AT LOADING PORT TIME FROM FRIDAY 5 PM OR 5 PM ON A DAY PRECEEDING A
HOLIDAY TILL  8 AM ON MONDAY OR 8 AM ON NEXT WORKING DAY NOT TO COUNT EIU.

-AT DISCHARGING PORT TIME FROM THURSDAY 17 PM OR 5 PM ON A DAY PRECEEDING
A HOLIDAY TILL 8 AM ON  SUNDAY  OR 8 AM ON NEXT WORKING DAY NOT TO COUNT
EIU.

-CARGO TO BE LOADED  AND DISCHARGED  ACCORING TO DRAFT SURVEY.  IF
SHIPPERS DO  NOT WANT  APPOINT DRAFT SURVEY  MASTER TO MAKE DRAFT SURVEY
IF ANY DIFFERENCE  IN QUANTITIY BS/L TO BE SIGNED AS PER  INSERT   SHORE
SCALE AGAINST CHARTERER  LOI -TIME LOST IN WAITING FOR BERTH AT
LOADING/DISCH TO COUNT AS LAYTIME W/W/W/W AND WITHIN TERMS, PROVISIONS,
EXCEPTIONS OF THIS C/P.
MASTER HAS THE RIGHT TO GIVE N.O.R. BY RADIO OR CABLE.
-LAYTIME FOR  LOADING AND DISCHARGING SHALL ANYCASE COMMENCE 08/14 CLS BENDS

-'CLEAN ON BOARD' BS/L PROVIDED CGO IN CONFORMITY.
-IF CLEAN ON BOARD BLS REQIRED,  MASTER HAS RIGHT TO REJECET UNSOUND,
UNCLEAN CARGO AND REPLACE WITH SOUND ONE AT CHTRS TIME AND EXPENSES.
-CLEAN BS/L SHALL BE SIGNED FOR CLEAN CARGO ONLY.
-TIME USED BEFORE COMMENCEMENT OF LAYTIME SHALL NOT COUNT EIU

-SHORE CRANES TO BE USED BENDS ON CHARTS TIME/RISK/ACCNT ENDS
-DEMURRAGE: 3300 .- USD PDPR FD BENDS
DEMURRAGE PAYABLE BY THE CHRTRS AFTER  15 DAYS  OF PRESENTATION OF S/F
DULY SIGNED BY THE MASTER AND AGENT AT LOADING/DISCH PORTS AND OWNERS T/S +
INVOICE

-ONCE ON DEMURRAGE ALWAYS ON DEMURRAGE

-LAYTIME TO COUNT TILL COMPLETION OF LOADING. UPON COMPLETION CHTRS HAVE
FREE 3 HOURS FOR CARGO DOCUMENTS PREPARATION WHICH ARE NOT COUNTED AS
LAYTIME. ANY EXTRA TIME  TO COUNT AS LAYTIME.
-TAXES DUES ON CGO CHRTRS ACCT
-TAXES DUES ON VSL AND OR FREIGHT OWS ACCT -VESSEL IS FREE OF EXTRA
INSURANCE ON CARGO DUE TO AGE, CLASS AND FLAG -DRAFT BS/L TO BE PRESENTED
FOR OWNERS APPROVAL

-VSL TO HAVE HOLDS CLEAN AND DRY PRIOR TO LOADING
-ARBITRATION IF ANY IN LONDON ACCORDING TO THE ENGLISH LAW

-ANY CLAIMS UPTO 20.000 USD TO BE SETTLED IN LONDON UNDER THE LMAA SMALL
CLAIM PROCEDURE -G/A YORK ANTWERP AND IN LONDON

-NEW BOTH TO BLAME COLLISION CLAUSE, NEW JASON CLAUSE, PARAMOUNT CLAUSE,
WAR RISK NO 1 AND 2 TO BE INTEGRANT PART OF THIS C/P

-CHRTRS AGENT ALL ENDS

FOZTRAFEGO Agência Marítima da Figueira - Figueira da Foz Av. Saraiva de

unknown_terms.context: SUBS/SHIPPERS /RECIEVERS  /UNDERWRITTERS   APPROVAL  TO BE LIFTED UPON  FIXING  MAINTERS LATEST  W/I 24W HRS — the 'W' in '24W HRS' is unrecognized; likely a typographic error for '24 HRS' (within 24 hours) but requires broker confirmation

LOADING/DISCH  5 TTL  WWDAYS OF 24 CONSEC HOURS SSHEX/TFHEX — TFHEX is listed in the glossary as Tropical Fridays and Holidays Excluded; flagged here because this is an unusual combination (SSHEX/TFHEX together) and Alexandria applies Friday holiday exclusions; broker should confirm whether this means TFHEX applies at discharge (Alex) and SSHEX at load (Portugal)

LAYTIME FOR  LOADING AND DISCHARGING SHALL ANYCASE COMMENCE 08/14 CLS BENDS — 'CLS' is not a recognized standard chartering abbreviation; likely refers to a time window (08:00 or 14:00) but precise meaning requires broker clarification
OWNERS T/S + INVOICE — used in demurrage payment clause; likely 'Time Sheet' but T/S is more commonly 'Transhipment'; requires confirmation
PRESENTATION OF S/F DULY SIGNED BY THE MASTER — likely 'Statement of Facts' (SOF) but S/F is not a standard abbreviation; requires confirmation

Email forwarded on 2026-04-05 (per outer email header) but the inner email (operative recap) is dated Wednesday 21 March 2018, with a laycan of 02/05 April 2018 and ETAs in March/April 2018. The 2026 date in the outer email header is the forwarding date only; all fixture terms relate to 2018. No conflict in fixture dates themselves — flagged for human awareness of the 8-year forwarding gap.
